exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal or caesarean section)
cohort: 24 primiparous women who delivered at Geneva University Hospital in 2012
finding: Perceived control, emotions, and the first moments with the newborn are important elements for the experience of childbirth, and these are perceived differently depending on the mode of delivery, with a negative connotation in the case of caesarean section.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery directly impacts on certain key delivery experience determinants as perceived control, emotions, and the first moments with the newborn.
